title: Reported conflict of interest over the éRE energy-renovation school
description: In January 2024, Le Monde (relayed by Rue89 Bordeaux) reported a potential conflict of interest: as Minister Delegate for Public Accounts, Cazenave remained 54% shareholder of the École de la rénovation énergétique he co-founded, while being involved in budget arbitrations on vocational training and energy renovation (and having been parliamentary rapporteur on a 2022 bill on energy renovation of buildings). A déport decree restricting him from decisions specifically concerning the school was signed by PM Élisabeth Borne on 4 January 2024, about six months after his appointment. Cazenave denied any conflict, said the National Assembly ethics adviser had found no incompatibility, that he had placed his shares under a third-party mandate without right of oversight, never held an operational role and never drew income from the company. No judicial investigation or charges were reported.
status: No judicial proceedings reported; addressed administratively via a déport decree (4 January 2024); denied by Cazenave
